title: bilattice-accessibility-relation
description: A four-valued accessibility relation R between worlds: a function from ordered pairs of worlds in a world set to elements of the twist product over a residuated lattice, recording the bilattice-valued accessibility from one world to another.

symbol.description: the relation symbol denoting this accessibility relation

worlds.description: the world set W; the relation is defined on the cartesian square W x W of its worlds

value-algebra.description: the twist product L^bowtie over a residuated lattice L, in which accessibility values live

value.description: R(w, w') in L^bowtie: the bilattice-valued accessibility from w to w'; when L = 2 this lands in FOUR, and the consistent sub-algebra recovers a classical Boolean Kripke accessibility relation
